game.title: Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines 2
game.blurb: Story-driven action role-playing game in which an elder vampire wakes in Seattle, from Hardsuit Labs (as RAWG lists it), released 2025-10-21. RAWG average playtime: 329 hours (very likely a RAWG data error). Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page under "Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines 2" (en dash) or "Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2" (hyphen). whitewolf.fandom.com redirects the en-dash title to "Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2", with about 119 links, mostly cast and crew, plus "Bloodlines 2 Achievements" and "Bloodlines 2 Quests" pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists Hardsuit Labs as the only developer and an average playtime of 329 hours, which looks wrong; both are passed on as RAWG gives them. 31 of 102 Steam achievements are hidden. Two add-on stories are named in the achievement text, "Loose Cannon" (played as Benny) and "The Flower & The Flame"; their hidden achievements were placed by position in the list (86 to 88 and 92 in Loose Cannon, 94, 95 and 99 to 101 in The Flower & The Flame), which needs checking. "Good Publicity" (restore adverts for the "Last Danse") and "Rope Trick" (93) name no add-on and were also placed by position. Six clan endings are in the main block (Banu Haqim, Brujah, Tremere, Ventrue) and later in the list (Lasombra, Toreador). The other hidden achievements sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder.
